notes: FRAGILITY: Medium. Aria-label and href-based nav detection. Instagram SVG path d values for Reels icon may change with tabs redesigns. Friends-Only Mode relies on /?variant=following URL parameter (durable since 2022) plus h1:has() rules for the feed-switcher pill and Back-to-For-You link; redirect runs at document-start via FilterService. Reel URLs (both /reel/<id>/ and /reels/<id>/ — IG 302-redirects the singular form to the plural) are intentionally NOT in blockedURLPatterns: the user must be able to view a reel a friend shared in DM. Single-reel enforcement lives entirely in filter.js: enforceSingleReel() locks to the first reel id seen and bounces on replaceState to a different id (verified: IG fires replaceState, not pushState, when advancing reels), and lockReelsPager() hides every reel slot in the snap-scroll container except the first plus disables overflow and touch on the container so the user can't swipe to the next slot. The Reels tab nav button is unreachable in-app via CSS rules, so the only path into a reel viewer is a friend-shared link in DM. v2.2.0 (2026-05-08): added a synthetic Friends-Only stories peek strip based on rendered feed authors. v2.3.0 (2026-08-19): added the `ads` group. It collapses feed articles only when an exact English, German, or Spanish sponsored marker appears structurally before the first media item, avoiding false positives from ordinary captions. v2.3.1 ignores hidden, pre-mounted dialogs when deciding whether filtering must pause, so inactive auth or composer DOM cannot suppress sponsored-post filtering. v2.3.2 scopes style/class observation to media-bearing Reels transitions on DM and Reels routes, avoids document-wide passes for unrelated animation churn, and ignores the Reels lock's own style writes once the lock is intact. v2.3.3 (2026-08-21): removed the synthetic story row because feed authors do not prove story availability; native Instagram story trays are preserved, and Friends-Only now defaults off with its upstream limitation disclosed. v2.3.4 (2026-08-21): requires multiple viewport-sized portrait videos before classifying a DM scroller as a Reels pager, deduplicates ancestor scans in media-heavy threads, recognizes localized native story trays, and limits structural story-tray detection to Home so DM controls stay usable. v2.3.5 (2026-08-21): rejects accessible live-message transcripts and requires Reel media to occupy most of the candidate pager width, preventing tall shared-video cards from freezing a compact or keyboard-reduced DM viewport. v2.3.6 (2026-09-08): widened the sponsored-marker table to the locale set the Facebook filter already recognizes (adds fr, it, nl, et plus "promoted" and "anzeige"), because Instagram localizes the label to the account language rather than Dull's UI language, and accepted a separator-delimited marker ("Sponsored · ...") which whole-string equality missed. Marker lookup moved from an object literal to an array scan so inherited keys such as "constructor" can no longer read as a match. Reported on UserJot by a lifetime purchaser three days after the ads filter shipped in 1.9.1. v2.3.7 (2026-09-08): the feed-card collapse for reels (CSS article:has(a[href*="/reel/"]) and processArticles()) stood down on single-post routes (/reel/<id>/, /reels/<id>/, /p/<id>/), which filter.js now marks on <html> as data-dull-single-post. A reel shared into Dull from outside opens Instagram's single-post page, itself an <article> full of /reel/ links, and both rules collapsed it into a black body under a "Post" header. Reproduced logged in on the simulator; the DM overlay was never affected because it is not an <article>. v2.4.0 (2026-10-09): ads, suggested and search, from two UserJot reports (one on iOS 26.7.1). Sponsored and "Suggested for you" posts are now found by walking the article header region (every node before the post's main media, avatars excluded) instead of only header span / span[dir=auto]; the feed renders the header as plain divs with the avatar img in it, so the old before-first-media check always lost to the avatar. Labels match whole or as "label · ...", never inside profile or location links, and per-post suggested labels now collapse the post rather than the label. Second ad signal on Home only: an outbound CTA link (l.instagram.com / l.facebook.com shim or a non-Meta host), which organic posts do not have. Suggested sections: the accounts carousel is collapsed as the smallest container with 2+ profile links and 2+ controls; everything after an end-of-feed "Suggested posts" heading is collapsed on every pass; DMs, search and auth routes are excluded. Collapsed elements carry data-dull-collapsed, hidden by an always-on CSS rule, so a React style rewrite cannot un-collapse them. The Explore group no longer hides the magnifier tab, which is the only search entry on mobile web; a tap on it and any bare /explore/ visit go to /explore/search/. Sponsored marker table extended with the uBO uAssets m.facebook.com locale set. 2.3.8 (2026-10-09): Friends-Only story compose. Instagram's Following variant renders no stories tray, and the tray's "Your story" tile is the only story composer entry on the mobile website, so Friends-Only removed story posting. On Following, when no usable native tray is visible, filter.js adds an "add to your story" button that stamps sessionStorage __dullStoryCompose and loads `/`; the document-start redirect lets `/` through for ten minutes and marks <html data-dull-story-compose> before first paint, and filter.css then hides everything except the tray, dialogs or full-screen overlays that appear after a tap in the tray, and Dull's bar. Leaving `/` ends compose. "Add to story" in a post's share sheet is native-app only; instagram.com does not offer it and Dull never hid it. Reported on UserJot. v2.4.1 (2026-10-11): collapsed feed posts (the reels rule and [data-dull-collapsed]) are 1px tall instead of 0. Instagram's Home feed keeps a few posts mounted and swaps the rest for spacers; with zero-height posts in the list it unmounted none. Simulator, logged in, For You, 60 swipes with the 1.9.2 filter set: 77 posts mounted and a 641 MB WebContent footprint at 0, 8 posts and 360 MB at 1px, 314 MB with nothing collapsed. Suspected, not reproduced on a device or in telemetry: iOS kills the grown page and process_recovery reloads Home from the top (UserJot 2026-09-17, "Instagram Refresh Issue", on 1.9.2). At 1px Instagram also remounts collapsed posts, and the new node of a post filter.js collapsed showed at full height until the next pass (945 such flashes in 40 swipes). Posts collapsed for a label are now remembered by permalink, a stylesheet rule collapses them on Home at first layout (0 flashes), and the blocked count counts a post once. Hide Suggested Posts now opens Home on Following, like Friends-Only (same document-start redirect, enforceFriendsOnly on SPA routes, FilterReapplyURLPolicy and the feed-switcher rules), because For You is mostly suggested posts: with 2.4.0 they were every post that was not a reel on the test account, so For You became a feed of collapsed posts that loaded another page on every swipe. At 0 WebContent memory went from 535 MB to 2.4 GB in 40 swipes; at 1px posts showed before their collapse and pulled the scroll position back to the top about 20 times in 40 swipes. Per-post "Suggested for you" posts are never collapsed on For You, which with the filter on only loads hidden under story compose; with the filter off For You keeps them and still hides ads and reels. The end-of-feed "Suggested posts" run is stopped instead of collapsed: posts after the heading take no space (data-dull-collapsed="feed-end"), the spinner below them is hidden, and <html data-dull-feed-end> turns the rubber-band bounce off, because at 1px (or 0) each bounce at the end loaded another page (live Following feed with an injected heading: 237 posts mounted and 726 MB after 60 swipes, scroll pulled back to the top; 23 posts, 365-419 MB and no further pages with the stop). DMs-only mode now owns Home over the Following redirect. Story compose: the Following tray seen live holds the same 24 unseen friends' stories as the For You tray on the test account, in another order, then the seen ones, but no "Your story"; some accounts get no tray there at all (UserJot 2026-10-06), which could not be reproduced. So the entry now shows whenever "Your story" is not on screen (friends' tiles used to hide it), is labelled for viewing as well when Hide Stories is off, and "Your story" is found by its caption (the tile's textContent includes its plus icon's <title>). A story opened from the compose tray (/stories/<user>/, pushed in the same document) no longer ends compose, so closing the viewer returns to the tray instead of reloading Following. Simulator, logged in, 60+ swipes each: defaults land on Following, 0 backward jumps, at most 18 posts mounted, 390-412 MB, no Follow buttons or Suggested labels, stories tray and Search tab present; Suggested off lands on For You, 0 jumps, 358 MB; Friends-Only with Suggested on, 396-400 MB, one 741 px backward scroll offset change at constant page height in one of two runs, not seen again in six later runs of 60-80 swipes (defaults three times, Suggested off, Friends-Only with and without Suggested; at most 14 posts mounted, 153-452 MB, 0 backward jumps, and in the one run that also tracked the post on screen, no shift over 100 px); with Suggested off, 390 MB, 0 jumps. The 1.9.2 filter set on For You, 60 swipes: 59 posts mounted, 328 to 666 MB and still growing, stories tray still at the top. The test account's Following feed ends after about 240,000 px with no "Suggested posts" run. Reels: processArticles collapsed every article with a link containing "/reel", which also matches /reels/audio/<id>/, the audio page a photo or carousel post with music links, and profiles whose name starts with "reel" (seen on For You); filter.css only matched /reel/, so such a post collapsed by filter.js laid out at full height when remounted. filter.js (REEL_LINK) and filter.css now agree: a link to /reel/<code>/ or /reels/<code>/, never /reels/audio/ or the bare /reels/ tab. Every post processArticles collapses is also remembered by permalink like a labelled one. The Reels-nav pass still hides a post's own /reels and Reel-icon links but no longer counts them, so a post with music counts once however often it is remounted; leaving those links in place inside collapsed reels made the live Following feed jump back about 240 px at the same spot in four of four runs. The end-of-feed spinner rule only touches spinners in <main>, where the live feed's spinner is; dialogs portal to <body>. Dull's injected copy (story entry and bar, reel interrupt) comes from the app in its language as __dullConfig.strings (en, de, es) and stays English without it, as on Android. Simulator, logged in, 80 swipes down and 20 up: defaults on Following in three runs, 0, 2 (757 px at constant page height, 1293 px) and 0 backward scroll jumps over 100 px (round-2 filters the same day: 0 and 1, 1275 px, at the same spot as one of these), 13 to 18 posts mounted, 441 to 475 MB, about 64 reels in about 140 posts and none shown, no visible Follow buttons or Suggested labels, stories tray and Search present; no photo or carousel post with music came up on that feed, so 0 hidden before and after there. Hide Suggested Posts off: For You, 0 jumps, 13 posts mounted, 450 MB. v2.5.0 (2026-10-15): saved posts and collections, from a UserJot report. A reel opened from the saved tab or a profile grid lands on /<user>/reel/<id>/, the same single-post page as /reel/<id>/ under the owner's name; SINGLE_POST_ROUTE only knew the bare form, so the reels card collapse hit it and the page went black under a "Post" header (reproduced logged in). The route now takes an optional username, as POST_PERMALINK already did; a profile's /<user>/reels/ tab is still not a single post. Simulator, logged in: a saved food reel plays on its Post page, and a swipe only scrolls to its caption (848 px page, no further reels). Collections: Instagram's website builds its collection picker only when PolarisUA.isDesktop() and opens it on mouse hover, its saved tab lists every saved post with no collections even on desktop, and the server answers /<user>/saved/<slug>/<id>/ with the profile for a phone UA, so on the site Dull loads a post can be saved but never filed, and a collection cannot be opened. After a tap on Save, filter.js shows a bar ("saved." / "add to collection") for 6 s and, on a tap, a sheet of the account's collections with a check on the ones holding the post, plus "+ new collection". It reads and writes through Instagram's own modules via window.require, the ones the desktop picker uses: PolarisSavedCollectionPickerQuery (first 50) for the list, PolarisAPIEditCollection to add and remove, PolarisAPICreateCollection (loaded with JSResourceForInteraction('PolarisCreateCollectionWithPostModal.react')) to create one with the post in it. The media id is the post's pk from the Relay store, else its shortcode decoded. Unsaving drops a post from every collection on the server, but Instagram's store keeps the old saved_collection_ids, so a save clears them and the sheet starts with nothing checked. If any module is missing nothing is shown and saving works as before. Simulator, logged in, real taps: save, add to a collection, create a collection, remove, each confirmed after a full reload from the server's saved_collection_ids. Viewing one collection is not possible on the phone site: the saved grid's media carry no saved_collection_ids and no loaded query fetches a collection's posts, so every saved post, reels included, is reachable from the saved tab and nothing narrower. v2.5.1 (2026-10-23): notifications, from a UserJot report ("won't let me follow back or show my notifications"). Instagram moved Activity from /accounts/activity/, which the suggested-sections pass skipped with /accounts/, to /notifications/ (the old URL now forwards there). Its "Suggested for you" <h4> sits alone in a wrapper div whose parent holds every notification section, so the carousel climb took that list (52 profile links, 43 buttons, Follow Back included) for the carousel and collapsed it: the page was blank under its header with Hide Suggested Posts on, on 1.9.3 and main alike. /notifications/ is now skipped like DMs and search, and the climb stops at any ancestor holding a profile link before the heading, since a suggestion block starts with its heading. Simulator, logged in: every notification and both Follow Back buttons show; a profile's Similar accounts panel still collapses alone. v2.5.2 (2026-10-23): Instagram's account switcher, from a UserJot report (2026-05-29, two profiles under one login, no way to switch in Dull). The username at the top of your own profile opens Instagram's "Switch accounts" sheet, and Dull never hid it. Only the sheet's list view holds the other profiles in the Accounts Center (fxSSO.igProfiles, loaded on every logged-in page from /api/v1/web/fxcal/ig_sso_users/; a tap switches through /api/v1/web/fxcal/ig_sso_login/), and the phone site opens that view only when Facebook's SDK reports a logged-in user or a saved one-tap login matches the browser's machine id. In Dull neither holds: Instagram rated the Facebook SDK ineligible (fb.status ig_ineligible, the SDK was never requested), and with no mid cookie the page can read the machine id is random per load, so a saved login never matches (Safari on the same simulator reads no mid cookie either). Simulator, logged in, 2026-10-23: the test account's second profile was in fxSSO.igProfiles and the sheet opened on a bare login form. filter.js now wraps PolarisAccountSwitcherActions.openAccountSwitcher: when Instagram opens the sheet on the form while its state holds another profile, it dispatches Instagram's own switchAuthType(oneTapLogin), and the sheet lists the profiles above "Log into an Existing Account". A caller that asks for a view keeps it, the form stays after "Log into an Existing Account", and if a module is missing the sheet opens as before.
